name: skillram-session-smoke
note: A small self-contained session suite for the memory hierarchy. Skills are synthetic and defined inline so the suite runs with no vaulted skills and no models. It is a development smoke test for resident-set behaviour, NOT a production accuracy claim: 4 sessions is far too few to rank eviction policies. See the dataset guidance in the project README before publishing anything from it.

skills.name: pdf-extraction
skills.description: Extract text, tables, and metadata from PDF documents
skills.body:
# pdf-extraction
Use pdfplumber for text and camelot for tables.

## Extracting text
Open the document and iterate pages.

## Extracting tables
Prefer lattice mode when the PDF has ruled lines.

## Metadata
Read the document info dictionary.

skills.name: table-parsing
skills.description: Parse and normalize tabular data into dataframes
skills.body:
# table-parsing
Normalize headers before joining tables.

## Header detection
Treat the first non-empty row as the header only when types agree.

## Type coercion
Coerce numeric columns after stripping currency symbols.

skills.name: chart-rendering
skills.description: Render charts and plots from tabular data
skills.body:
# chart-rendering
Choose the mark from the question, not the data shape.

## Axis defaults
Always label axes with units.

skills.name: sql-migrations
skills.description: Write and review reversible SQL schema migrations
skills.body:
# sql-migrations
Every migration needs a tested rollback.

## Backfills
Backfill in batches outside the transaction.

skills.name: react-review
skills.description: Review React components for correctness and performance
skills.body:
# react-review
Measure before recommending an optimization.

## Re-render checks
Look for unstable props before reaching for memo.

skills.name: travel-planning
skills.description: Plan trips, itineraries, and travel logistics
skills.body:
# travel-planning
Confirm visa requirements before booking.

## Itineraries
Leave buffer between connections.
